What we offer:
- A direct employment contract with Air In Motion (no temporary agency contracts).
- Employment according to the applicable collective labour agreement (CAO) and participation in our pension scheme.
- Technical experience is not required. Candidates with experience in logistics or production are also very welcome. We are happy to teach you the technical skills.
- Within our team, both Dutch and English are spoken, so international colleagues quickly feel at home.

We are a family business consisting of 6 people.
We work day shifts.
When you work in Ysselsteyn, the working hours are from 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM.
When there is an installation at a customer's location, we usually drive from Ysselsteyn at 7:30 AM, sometimes earlier.
For some jobs -installation or maintenance-, you may be required to stay overnight in a hotel for 1, 2, or more nights. This is due to the travel time to the work location.
Never longer than a week and notified at least 3 months in advance. We work worldwide, the locations we visit ourselves are the Netherlands, Belgium, and Germany, plus one week per year to the UK for maintenance on dehumidifiers.
Approximately a maximum of 20 overnight stays per year. We work on a project basis, so it is difficult to say which projects/where installations will take place. 80 procent of the work can be done without an overnight stay.

We are a family business and are looking for a serious colleague who can build the dehumidifier themselves, perform installations with colleagues, carry out maintenance at customer sites, and eventually deliver projects independently.

We work under a collective labor agreement (CAO), you accrue pension in the Netherlands, and overtime is paid.
You have 25 vacation days per year, and because we work 40 hours per week, you also accrue 2 hours of time off in lieu, which you can use as vacation days. The collective labor agreement stipulates that full-time work consists of 38 hours of work per week.

Je nieuwe baan
As a Working Foreman at Krohne, you are the link between the team leader and the shop floor. You lead, keep oversight and work hands-on in production yourself. At an international company like Krohne in Dordrecht, where around 650 people work daily on precision measuring instruments, your role truly matters. You naturally command respect, know how to motivate people and switch effortlessly between leading and hands-on working. This is your place.
Your responsibilities
-
Motivating, directing and supporting your colleagues on the shop floor.
-
Working alongside the team in the production process — you lead by example.
-
Assembling components (such as electrodes) in and on the measuring tube, amplifier housing and jacket.
-
Checking, calibrating, measuring and packing flowmeters.
-
Monitoring quality and flagging deviations.
-
Presenting the daily start-up meeting and identifying trends in methods, people or materials.
-
Processing production data in AFAS (ERP) and Excel.
Wat we van jou verwachten
-
You naturally command respect and know how to bring people along.
-
You communicate clearly, both on the shop floor and during the daily start-up meeting.
-
You have a good command of both Dutch and English.
-
You have experience in a production environment.
-
You are proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel in particular) and/or AFAS.
-
You are solution-oriented, a quick learner and broadly deployable.
-
You are available to work in a 2-shift schedule (morning shift 06:00 to 15:15 and evening shift 14:45 to 00:00).

Gross monthly salary between € 3,200 and € 4,000 (depending on experience) — including 14% shift allowance this amounts to € 3,648 to € 4,560 gross per month.

jobs.description:
Bus driver Public Transport the Netherlands

Who are we 
The Toonen Reizen coaches have been well-known on the national and international road network for almost 100 years. The fleet now includes 35 luxury coaches in various sizes. They are multifunctional for company and crew transportation, day trips, international shuttles, school trips, vacation trips and national and international events. The fleet also includes buses for sports clubs and buses for partner Flixbus. Toonen Reizen works for a wide variety of target groups, from business to individuals, and from young people to the elderly. In recent years, the company has grown without losing its family-like work environment. We work with a team of almost 100 drivers who make sure customers arrive to their destinations pleasantly and safely. 

Job Description
Toonen Reizen has a partnership with Arriva and Transdev for public transport. A number of our drivers assist them due to staff shortages and carry out public transport lines. It involves operating fixed public transport routes, with shifts scheduled during the day, night, and weekends, using various buses, including articulated buses. The collaboration is for a minimum of six months, with the possibility of an extension.
With Toonen Reizen, you will have an employment contract for 164 hours per month. These are fixed hours and it is not a flexible contract. You will carry out all work for Arriva or Transdev and will be scheduled and managed by them. Cost of accommodation are covered and no deductions are made from your salary for this.
Should the collaboration be terminated or come to an end, then there is a possibility to work at the headquarters in the Netherlands and drive all kind of touring coach work. At that point, you will be responsible for your own accommodation, though we will certainly assist you with this. You will find more about our regular coach operations below.

Our offer
•    You will be considered for a contract for six-months with fixed hours (164 hours per month). With the prospect of extension and a permanent contract. 
•    You will be given a variety of clothing to wear during trips;
•    An independent and responsible position in a leading organization within the industry;
•    For salary, the collective bargaining agreement for Private Bus Transportation will be adhered to. This means that your basic CLA salary is between € 3,014.72 and € 3,630.42 per month (based on a full-time contract, before taxes and mandatory insurance). Your salary will be determined based on age and experience;
•    100% of hours (including breaks) are paid;
•    A commuting allowance is provided for distances between 10 and 45 kilometers, at €0.23 per kilometer. 
•    You are also eligible for the irregularity, night and weekend bonuses;
•    We will meet with you yearly to understand how satisfied you are in your job and which skills you would like to develop.
•    We cover the costs for refreshing Code 95.

What do you bring?
•    You hold a European nationality.
•    You have a You have a driver's license D and code 95. 
•    You should be able to submit a Certificate of Conduct 
•    You have a good proficiency of the English language. Speaking a little bit Dutch is a bonus. 
•    You are flexible and enjoy working on different hours. 
- Minimum of 1 year experience as a Busdriver
